Yugoslavia, the country that was so peaceful that British pensioners would holiday there in the summers, but then exploded suddenly into a war in 1992. In this the first of what I hope will be a three part series, I travelled to one of the former republics of Yugoslavia to see how life is and what remains of those happy past times. Join me.
title: I Investigated What Remains Of Yugoslavia
